gemini.performance_metric: net income rising each year from $109.8 million (2014) to $172.2 million (2018)
gemini.rationale: The slice documents a successful, continuous operation with net income rising monotonically from 2014 to 2018. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption (p4_pathway) or process/organization fracture (p5_pathway), as the company maintained its three divisions and reported no goodwill impairment or divestitures.

grok.performance_metric: net income rose $109.8M (2014) to $172.2M (2018); no divestiture
grok.rationale: The FY2018 10-K record shows the separated entity continued as one regulated natural-gas distribution segment across three divisions with ~2.2M customers and monotonically rising net income, with no product/process misalignment or operational incoherence documented. No process/organization fracture is reported; headcount (~3,500), collective-bargaining status, and division structure remained intact, and no goodwill impairment or core-business divestiture occurred in the window.

openai.performance_metric: Net income rose from $109.8 million in 2014 to $172.2 million in 2018
openai.rationale: No realized product/process disruption is documented: ONE Gas continued operating its three natural-gas distribution divisions, serving approximately 2.2 million customers, with no core-business divestiture reported. No realized process/organization fracture is documented: the company retained roughly 3,500 employees and maintained continuous operations while net income rose each year from 2014 through 2018.
